journey.title: Refine the search and choose the highlighted fruit with Enter
journey.goal: After the suggestions are refined, Enter selects the suggestion that is highlighted

functionalJourney.title: Choose a fruit with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a suggestion fills the fruit field

guards.title: Choose the second suggestion with arrow keys
guards.goal: ArrowDown twice and Enter selects the second suggestion

plan.root_cause: The Enter key does not trigger selection of the highlighted suggestion; the navigation controller handles arrow keys but lacks an Enter key handler to invoke the onSelection callback.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener for the Enter key in the autoComplete.init() method. When Enter is pressed while the list is open, retrieve the element referenced by aria-activedescendant, obtain its text value, call the onSelection callback with that value, close the list, and prevent default form submission.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Ensures that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion in the combobox, providing keyboard operability and conforming to WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Possible duplicate selection if navigationController already handles Enter key
May interfere with custom onSelection expectations if they rely on mouse clicks only
Potential side effects if closeAllLists is not defined in scope (but it is imported)
verification_requirements: After typing 'bl' and pressing Down to highlight Blackberry, pressing Enter sets the input value to 'Blackberry'
The suggestion list closes after Enter selection
ArrowUp/Down navigation and Escape to close list continue to work as before

attempts.failure: Candidate build failed: [{"file":"src/autoComplete.js","pass":false,"kind":"syntax","message":"JavaScript syntax check failed"}]

plan.root_cause: The src/autoComplete.js file contains two syntax errors: (1) a case-sensitive variable name mismatch in compose() where 'triggerCondition' is used instead of 'triggerCondition', and (2) a block of executable statements (data feedback, rendering, navigation, click listener) placed directly in the class body instead of inside a method, which is invalid JavaScript syntax.
plan.repair_strategy: Fix the variable name typo in compose() and wrap the floating code block into a new async start(input, query) method that computes matching results via listMatchingResults, then performs the existing feedback, rendering, and navigation logic. This resolves the syntax error and provides the missing start() method that compose() calls.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Fixes the syntax error so the autocomplete initializes correctly, enabling keyboard operability (WCAG 2.1.1) and focus order (2.4.3) for the combobox. The Enter key handler added in a previous step can now function because the component loads without syntax errors.
functional_risks: The start() method adds a document click listener each time it runs; multiple searches may register duplicate listeners.
If this.data.results is not a function, the ternary falls back to listMatchingResults, which is the intended behavior.
The click listener closure captures 'this' correctly but may close lists from other instances if multiple exist.
verification_requirements: Typing 'bl' shows suggestions, ArrowDown highlights items, Enter selects highlighted value.
Form submission yields the selected fruit value.

plan.root_cause: The autoComplete component lacks an Enter key handler to select the currently highlighted suggestion. The navigation controller handles arrow key navigation but there is no keydown listener for Enter to invoke the onSelection callback with the highlighted item's value.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown event listener in the init() method that triggers when Enter is pressed while the suggestion list is open (aria-expanded=true). The handler retrieves the element referenced by aria-activedescendant, obtains its text value, calls the onSelection callback, closes the list, and prevents default form submission.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Ensures that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion in the combobox, providing keyboard operability and conforming to WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Possible duplicate selection if navigationController already handles Enter key
May interfere with custom onSelection expectations if they rely on mouse clicks only
Potential side effects if closeAllLists is not defined in scope (but it is imported)
verification_requirements: After typing 'bl' and pressing Down to highlight Blackberry, pressing Enter sets the input value to 'Blackberry'
The suggestion list closes after Enter selection
ArrowUp/Down navigation and Escape to close list continue to work as before
